It Must Have Been The Roses

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin'** (4 reviews): The Truckin' into Eyes Of The World sequence is singled out as a highlight of a two-disc show; The Truckin' into Eyes Of The World segment is praised as great [6][7][13][15]
- **Slipknot!** (3 reviews): This show is where Slipknot! first appeared, according to the reviewer; Jerry leads the band through Slipknot!, developing the theme early, shown as the band learning on the fly [5][8][9]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Scarlet Begonias is described as tasty; Scarlet Begonias is well done, with the newer 1974 songs sounding ripe [9][12]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Jerry's playing on China Cat Sunflower seems to roam all over the place [15]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Playing on this Eyes is called electric, leading into the first-ever appearance of Slipknot! [5]

## Setlist highlights

- Earliest performances in the archive: Slipknot! [16]

## The recordings

- **gd74-06-20.sbd.clugston.2179.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 143 min; rated 4.4/5 by 43 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound muddy compared with other 1974 shows on the site; Mix is bass heavy with great drums; Technical pops and snaps are audible during the first few minutes of Truckin' [7][8][13]
- **gd1974-06-20.sbd.remaster.105427.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 139 min; rated 3/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Analysis says it drops 4:14 of between-song tuning and has levels raised past maximum [2]
- **gd1974-06-20.sbd-set2.finney.211.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 67 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer rates the best Eyes as the Providence one six days later, but ranks this one among the top [4]
- Show is somewhat short for 1974, though solid throughout [7]
- Eyes ranks high, though the Kentucky show two days earlier is judged tighter [8]
- Reviewer thinks the show is overlooked next to Freedom Hall, Des Moines and other nearby dates [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd74-06-20.sbd.clugston.2179.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Master 7-inch two-track soundboard reel, then cassette, DAT and CDR; uploaded by Scott Clugston to abgd, later etree; Disc one was tracked at about 80 minutes [1]
- **gd1974-06-20.sbd.remaster.105427.flac16**: transferred by ChinaCat66; source: SBD > MR > Cassette > DAT > CD [2]. Also: This remaster is described as a retracking of SHNID 2179 [2]
- **gd1974-06-20.sbd-set2.finney.211.shnf**: source: SBD > ? > CD [3]
